module Test.REQ.05a

function positive(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n > 0
ensures result > 0
is
    return n
end positive
procedure bad_call()
is
    let n: Integer = positive(-1)
    call Std.IO.logf("n=${}", n)
end bad_call

end Test.REQ.05a
